waivers.verdict: Claim Anthony Richardson for $23 into the spot the Bowers trade opened. With Young gone, Goff and Cousins are your only healthy quarterbacks until Lamar returns. $23 is $1 more than GehrmannJake's entire budget, and they're the team most likely to want him.

lineup.verdict: Gesicki in for Kraft at TE (bye) and Warren in for Washington at FLEX — both an easy call on the numbers. Keep Goff at QB; start Young over Cousins at SUPER_FLEX on the matchup.

trades.verdict: Accept annaf23's counter: Bryce Young + Tucker Kraft for Brock Bowers. Ahead in every playoff week on both methods, nothing lost this week (Kraft's on bye, Young's points today stay yours), and Gesicki stays at TE.

inactives.verdict: No starter carries an injury tag and nothing in today's news flips that — hold the lineup as set.
